FROM t_job WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
AND title ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.title}, '%')
AND company ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.company}, '%')
AND status = #{query.status}
AND ( skills @> jsonb_build_array(#{query.skill}) OR skills::text ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.skill}, '%') )
mapper.select:
SELECT id, title, company, department, location, job_type, COALESCE(skills, '[]'::jsonb)::text AS skills_json, status, created_at, updated_at
ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT id, title, company, department, location, job_type, experience_required, education_required, salary_min, salary_max, description, requirements, COALESCE(skills, '[]'::jsonb)::text AS skills_json, status, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM t_job WHERE id = #{jobId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_job (title, company, department, location, job_type, experience_required, education_required, salary_min, salary_max, description, requirements, skills, status, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{request.title}, #{request.company}, #{request.department}, #{request.location}, #{request.jobType}, #{request.experienceRequired}, #{request.educationRequired}, #{request.salaryMin}, #{request.salaryMax}, #{request.description}, #{request.requirements}, CAST(#{request.skillsJson} AS jsonb), #{request.status}, #{request.createdBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE t_job SET title = #{request.title}, company = #{request.company}, department = #{request.department}, location = #{request.location}, job_type = #{request.jobType}, experience_required = #{request.experienceRequired}, education_required = #{request.educationRequired}, salary_min = #{request.salaryMin}, salary_max = #{request.salaryMax}, description = #{request.description}, requirements = #{request.requirements}, skills = CAST(#{request.skillsJson} AS jsonb), status = #{request.status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{request.id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE t_job SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{jobId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
